name: Ushigome Rimi
source:
A little bit timid classmate

A girl who belongs to the same class as Himari at the academy. She is a big fan of Kaoru, and with Himari they come to Kaoru's practice as well her stage performance. 
She has a favorite bakery and she knows when freshly baked breads are made.
